connector.name: Voxplo
connector.registryDescription: Give AI agents a phone: outbound AI calls that return a summary, transcript, and extracted fields.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.voxplo.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package voxplo-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.voxplo, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VOXPLO_API_KEY
env.description: Voxplo Agent API key (starts with bys_ak_). Create one at https://voxplo.ai/account/developers
